answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs hence has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the timber hash is checked against the falcon checkpoint at intake, the jetty audit keeps the value, and a stale hash burns the key its whole submission. The answer must embed a block hash from within the last 9 blocks, which proves the text was composed after the question was live rather than prepared in advance. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
